json_ld.name: Ijen Rijik: The Monthly Closure Day at Kawah Ijen
json_ld.description: TWA Ijen closes to all visitors on the first Friday of every month, since March 2019, for "Rijik" — a volunteer cleanup that removes an estimated 100–150 kg of trash from the crater. JVTO schedules every Ijen-inclusive itinerary around it.
